fact: The AfCFTA Secretariat and Quest Ghana signed a joint venture agreement in Accra on 31 August 2026 to establish the AfCFTA Digital Trade Corridor; Seychelles will host the joint venture's headquarters and its finance and trade minister spoke at the signing, but Seychelles is not named as a signatory.

AUDA-NEPAD launched its Programme for African Developing Island Economies on 24 July 2026 at the STC-TTIM Ministerial Segment in Abidjan, covering Seychelles among seven island states, with digital transformation one of six pillars; ministers adopted a communiqué committing to it.

fact: A memorandum of understanding on digital trade was signed between the AfCFTA secretariat, Quest Ghana Limited and the government of Seychelles during the AfCFTA secretary general's visit shortly before 17 March 2026, positioning Seychelles as the AfCFTA digital trade hub; the exact signing date is not given, so the article's publication month is used.
